legal.draftNotice: Informational draft prepared with the product. It must be reviewed by a lawyer before public launch.

s1.title: 1. Who we are
s1.body: Plano A is operated by {company} ("we"), the controller of the personal data processed in the app. To talk about privacy or exercise your rights, write to {email}.

s2.title: 2. Data we process
s2.body:
- Account: email and password (the password is stored in protected form by the authentication provider).
- Content you record: dreams, goals, actions, habits, gratitude, My Space entries, projects, financial data you enter, dream board images and texts, Time Capsule messages and lesson progress.
- Preferences: language, currency and time zone.
- Subscription: plan status and dates. Card data stays with the payment processor; we do not store it.
- App usage: only if you opt in to helping improve Plano A, pseudonymized and without any text you write.

s3.title: 3. Why we use it and legal bases
s3.body:
- To provide the service you signed up for (performance of a contract).
- To send the Time Capsule on the day you chose (performance of a contract).
- To generate personalized daily Affirmations (performance of a contract).
- To process subscriptions and payments (performance of a contract and legal obligation).
- To measure usage and improve the product (your consent, which you can withdraw in Settings).
- To protect the service against abuse and fraud (legitimate interest).

s4.title: 4. Who we share it with
s4.body:
We use providers (processors) that handle data on our behalf, only for the purposes above:

- Supabase: database, authentication and file storage.
- Vercel: app hosting.
- Resend: sending the Time Capsule email (receives your email and the message).
- Stripe: payments and subscriptions.
- Anthropic: generating Affirmations (receives texts of your open dreams and goals, not your email).

We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

s5.title: 5. International transfers
s5.body: Some providers may store or process data outside Brazil. We rely on contracts and safeguards consistent with the LGPD for these transfers.

s6.title: 6. How long we keep it
s6.body: We keep your data while your account exists. When you delete the account in Settings, data is erased from the database and dream board files are removed; backups may take a limited time to expire. Payment records may be kept for as long as the law requires. Pseudonymized usage events do not identify you.

s7.title: 7. Your rights
s7.body:
Under the LGPD you may: confirm that we process your data, access it, correct it, request portability, delete data, withdraw consent and ask about sharing.

In the app you can already download your data and delete your account in Settings. For other requests, write to {email}.

s8.title: 8. Security
s8.body: We use encrypted connections, per-user access control in the database (each person can only access their own data), private files with temporary links and abuse limits. No system is completely invulnerable; in case of a relevant incident we will notify you and the competent authority as required by law.

s9.title: 9. Minors and changes
s9.body: Plano A is intended for people over 18. We may update this policy; relevant changes will be announced in the app.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance
s1.body: By creating an account on Plano A, operated by {company}, you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

s2.title: 2. What Plano A is
s2.body: A personal development and life planning platform: dreams, goals, actions, habits, personal finances, guided content and reflection tools.

s3.title: 3. Your account
s3.body: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for activity on your account. Provide truthful information and be at least 18 years old.

s4.title: 4. Not professional advice
s4.body: Content and tools are for education and personal organization. They do not replace financial, accounting, legal, medical or psychological advice. Important decisions, such as leaving a job or taking on debt, should consider your situation and, where needed, qualified professionals. Simulations (such as debt payoff) are estimates and may differ from reality.

s5.title: 5. AI-generated content
s5.body: Affirmations are generated by AI from what you record and may contain inaccuracies. Use your own judgment.

s6.title: 6. Your content
s6.body: What you record remains yours. You authorize us only to store and process it to operate the service for you. Do not use the app for illegal content or content that infringes others' rights.

s7.title: 7. Paid plans
s7.body: The Premium plan is a recurring subscription billed by the payment processor. You can cancel anytime from the subscription portal; access continues until the end of the period already paid. For purchases made at a distance, you have a 7-day right of withdrawal under Brazilian consumer law. Prices shown on the plans page are the current ones.

s8.title: 8. Availability and liability
s8.body: We aim to keep the service available and secure, but it is provided "as is", with no guarantee of uninterrupted operation. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the app.

s9.title: 9. Termination, changes and jurisdiction
s9.body: You can delete your account anytime in Settings. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms. We may update the terms and will announce relevant changes. Brazilian law applies, and the consumer's home forum is chosen to settle disputes. Contact: {email}.
